title: mavi
summary: This article recounts a humorous and slightly embarrassing incident in Hong Kong where the author and friends were initially denied entry to a hip party. Their fortunes changed thanks to a model friend who provided a quick wardrobe change. The story highlights the unexpected twists of a night out and the importance of having resourceful friends.
excerpt: Hong Kong. Hip party, we're invited – on the list. Great, but we're laughed at and sent away at the door. Damn, because our apartment is on Peng Chau Island. Fortunately, our handsome model friend helps us out. Off to his apartment, into his Mavi jeans, and back to the club. Happy ending.

## mavi

Hong Kong. Hip party, we're invited – on the list. Great, but we're laughed at and sent away at the door. Shit, because our apartment is on Peng Chau Island. Fortunately, our handsome model friend helps us out. Off to his apartment, into his Mavi jeans, and back to the club. Happy ending.
